The approved, starred v3 model's export record conflicts: its named d1c… archive GLB has the same bytes as the independently identified 88a… Banshee source GLB. Keep Hedge held until a raw export is verified to match v3; do not use the denied v2 or ambiguous export.

assets.note: The approved Chainbound image hashes to the batch record, but that record is not independent evidence that the downloaded model matches it. Keep the existing authored game asset and do not build from the conflicting GLB until source identity is resolved.
